diagnosis: The customer removed seats mid‑cycle and sees no credit on the current invoice. According to our policy, seat removals are applied at the next renewal and are not credited immediately. We need the disputed line item, invoice ID, and the expected credit amount to investigate further.
reply: Thank you for contacting us. Seat removals are applied at the time of your next renewal and are not credited on the current invoice, as described in our billing policy. To review your invoice dispute (INV-88410) and the expected $1,200 credit, could you please confirm the specific line item you believe is incorrect and the exact amount you expected? Once we have that information we can begin a formal review. We appreciate your patience while we investigate this matter.
